import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
const root=process.cwd();
const full=f=>path.join(root,f);
const read=f=>fs.readFileSync(full(f),'utf8');
const write=(f,c)=>{fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(full(f)),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(full(f),c)};
const replace=(f,o,n,count=1)=>{const s=read(f);const hits=s.split(o).length-1;if(hits!==count)throw new Error(`guard ${f}: expected ${count}, found ${hits}`);write(f,s.split(o).join(n))};
